ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 4:1 ratio of high-intensity white (central lobes) to low-intensity black (lateral and trailing margins).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white high-intensity zone occupying the central 75% of the fluke surface. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous border along the lateral and trailing edges, with high-frequency black mottling clusters occurring at the grayscale transition zone, particularly on the inner lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a depth of approximately 10-15% of the total lobe vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the entire span; notable large-amplitude irregular peaks located mid-lobe on both left and right trailing edges, isolated against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex geometric curve along the lateral edges sweeping upward toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of localized high-contrast dark pixel clusters on the white field of the left lobe and inner right lobe, consistent with rosette-style pigmentation patterns.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: High-relief textured clusters (barnacles) visible at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
